audited_head: nine color prints and nine line prints of batch 42, and the nine reference pictures in refs/
verdict: eight of nine rows pass under the bar; the sun row fails because the line art reads as a flower

seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/brief.md: Batch 42 brief; nine check rows; Daniel's bar at the top; the builder listed open items per row.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_s: Alligator prop sheet: a baby green alligator with a cream belly, a long rounded snout with a smile and small white teeth, two big round eyes, facing left; the prints face right.
Ant prop sheet m2: a dark red-brown ant with three round body parts, six legs, two short curved antennae, two big eyes and a small smile.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_a: Apple asset: a round red apple with a short brown stem and one green leaf.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_b: Bed asset: a wooden bed with a red check blanket, one white pillow, an arched headboard and four posts.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_s: School bus asset: a yellow bus with blue windows, a dark door, round headlights, a front grille, roof lights and a dark side stripe.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_d: Dog asset: a small brown puppy with dark floppy ears, a white muzzle and chest, a red collar with a gold tag and the tongue out.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_f: Fish asset: a round fish in side view, blue on top and yellow below, one big round eye with a yellow ring, a scalloped yellow top fin and tail and one small side fin.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/refs/out_s: Sun prop sheet: a round orange-yellow disc with eight short rounded rays that do not touch the disc; each ray is wider at its outer end; a soft glow sits behind the disc.
seen.out/storytime-review/batch-42/pages/l2-w: One baby green alligator, cream belly, big round eyes, smile with small white teeth, three-quarter view, on white with a soft shadow; no text.
Line art of the same alligator: even 19 px lines, teeth as small closed shapes, two eyes as rings with solid black pupils, short open crease strokes at the legs and chest.
One dark red-brown ant, three round body parts, six legs, two curved antennae, one big eye and a small smile, on white with a soft shadow; a sliver of the second eye shows at the head edge; no text.
Line art of the same ant: even 16 px lines, closed rounded legs, closed curled antennae, one full eye ring with a solid pupil and a second eye as a thin ring with a pupil at the edge of the head.
One whole red apple with a short brown stem and one green leaf, on white with a soft shadow; no text.
Line art of the same apple: one closed round outline, a closed stem, a closed leaf and one small open dimple curve at the stem base.
One wooden bed with a red check blanket, one white pillow, an arched headboard and four posts, on white with a soft shadow; no text.

Line art of the same bed: bold even 16 px lines, one pillow as a closed oval, a plain blanket, a headboard with one arched opening drawn as a double line, posts and legs; the check pattern is not drawn.

One yellow school bus in a front three-quarter view, blue windows, dark door, round headlights, front grille, roof lights, dark side stripe, two wheels and a hint of the far front wheel, on white with a soft shadow; no text.

Line art of the same bus: even 14 px lines, closed windows and door, headlight rings, open horizontal grille lines, small roof-light rings, wheel rings with hubcap rings and one stripe line along the side.
One small brown puppy, dark floppy ears, white muzzle chest and paws, red collar with a gold tag, tongue out, two big round eyes and white eyebrow dots, on white with a soft shadow; no text.

Line art of the same puppy: even 17 px lines, closed ears, two eye rings with solid pupils, two small outlined eyebrow rings, one solid black nose, closed tongue, collar with a tag ring and leg lines with small paw marks.
One round fish in side view, blue on top and yellow below, one big round eye with a yellow ring, scalloped yellow top fin and tail, one small side fin, on white with a soft shadow; no text.

Line art of the same fish: even 22 px lines, one closed body outline, closed top fin and tail, one eye ring with a solid pupil, one closed side-fin oval and one small closed nub at the lower left of the body.

One pink pig, big head, two floppy ears, two big dark eyes, snout with two nostrils, curly tail, four dark hooves, fuzzy skin texture and two small marks above the eyes, on white with a soft shadow; no text.

Line art of the same pig: even 22 px lines, two ears with inner shapes, two eye rings with solid pupils (the far eye clipped by the head edge), a snout with two open oval nostrils, a curly closed tail and four legs with hoof marks.
One round orange-yellow disc with eight short rounded rays that do not touch the disc, on white with a soft glow; no text; each ray is wider at its outer end.
Line art: one circle with eight closed rounded-triangle rays around it; the rays do not touch the circle; each ray is wider at its outer end than at its inner end; no face and no ground line.

line_art_solid_black_scan.method: visual inspection of each line print at full size and enlarged crops; the week 1 refusal was for thick solid black rings or bands, so every solid black area was located and classified
line_art_solid_black_scan.result: every solid black area is an allowed fill: eye pupils on alligator, ant, dog, fish and pig, plus the dog nose, which is a standard solid fill in coloring pages; no thick solid black ring and no thick solid black band stands in any line print; every outline keeps one normal width

goal_check.nothing else, no ground line, no backgro: yes: white background with at most a soft shadow in both files
goal_check.reads as alligator at book size, in the: yes: the long snout, smile, teeth and tail read as an alligator in both files
goal_check.face shows where the object has a face: yes: two eyes show in both files

critical: the sun line art reads as a flower: each of the eight rays is a closed rounded shape that is wider at its outer end than at its inner end, and no ray touches the disc, so the picture is a center with petals around it; a teacher can read it as a flower
defects: line art rays shaped like petals: wider at the outer end, detached from the disc, so the line art fails the check that the picture reads as the word sun

goal_check.exactly one sun: no for the line art: the line art can read as one flower; the color print does read as one sun
goal_check.whole object in view: yes: disc and all rays sit inside the frame in both files
goal_check.nothing else, no ground line, no backgro: yes: white background with at most a soft glow in both files
goal_check.reads as sun at book size, in the line a: no: the color print reads as a sun through its warm yellow-orange colors and glow, but the line art is a circle with eight detached petal-shaped rays, and a teacher can read it as a flower
goal_check.one sun, plain, no face: yes in both files: no face shows

open_items_judged.the sun rays do not touch the disc (colo: held against the flower test, the gap is not the defect on its own; the defect is the ray shape, and the gap strengthens the petal reading
open_items_judged.rays are closed shapes, not a flower: not met: the rays are closed shapes, but each ray is wider at its outer end, which is the petal convention; a child or teacher can read the line art as a flower

minor_differences.color support: the color print keeps a sun reading through warm colors and the glow, so the color file alone would pass; the check row fails on the line art

l2-w02-check-row-sun.retry_hint: make each ray narrower at its outer end or pointed, and let the rays touch or nearly touch the disc, so the line art cannot read as petals around a center

workbooks_stage_2_findings.thick solid black ring or band in the li: gone: every solid black area is an eye pupil or the dog nose; no ring and no band stands in any line print
workbooks_stage_2_findings.gray or shading in the line art: none: all nine line prints hold 0 pixels that are not 0 or 255
workbooks_stage_2_findings.a face part that the word names must sho: met for the objects with eyes: alligator, ant, dog, fish and pig show their eyes in both files
workbooks_stage_2_findings.each row shows exactly one object, whole: met on all nine rows: one object per file, whole in view, white background, no ground line, no second object, no text

batch_notes.builder_open_items_judged: fish nub: not a defect; bus open grille lines: not a defect; sun rays detached from the disc: feeds the flower reading but is not the defect alone; ant second eye as a thin ring at the head edge: not a defect
batch_notes.orchestrator_flower_concern: confirmed for the line art: the rays are wider at the outer end, so the sun line art reads as a flower; the sun row is not clean
notes_for_the_builder: alligator, ant and pig carry the same far-eye convention: a ring with a solid pupil clipped by the head edge; it reads as an eye in all three
the ant line art shows five full legs plus small far-side stubs; it matches the six-leg reference at book size
the bed line art draws the blanket plain while the color file shows a red check; keep the plain blanket

summary.workbooks_findings_gone_count: all checks pass on eight rows; the sun row fails the word reading, not a workbooks stage 2 finding
